basic_info.description: What helps you relax? Whatever your go to, the sounds of waves breaking, fog horns, and seabirds can't hurt. Whether enjoying morning coffee at Andytown's beachfront location, a sunset stroll on the beach, the easy access to surf, or proximity to Golden Gate Park's many amenities (golf, archery, shady hiking paths, and soccer), you will love living here. While this condo has its location going for it, the home itself is also a gem. The unit has been freshly painted, with newer hardwood style floors in public spaces and brand new carpet in the bedrooms. The baths have been upgraded with tile floors and vanities.  The primary suite features dual closets and a double vanity with new sea foam hexoganal tile floors and stylish new light fixture too. The large great room features a decorative fireplace and access to a spacious deck to catch a breath of fresh air or enjoy the morning sunshine. There are in-unit stacked laundry, a separate storage cage and a side by side parking space in the underground garage.  HOA dues include building insurance, water, and garbage in additional common area maintenance, professional management and reserves.  Additional amenities in the building include an elevator, gym, a library and, coming in 2025, a pet washing station. What a place to call home!
